record.question: In which city was India's first specialised hospital for elephants opened?
record.explanation: Answer B: Mathura. Wildlife SOS records that it established India’s first specialized elephant hospital in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, in 2018 with the state Forest Department. Mathura is therefore the relevant city. Historical/source note: The specifically designed elephant hospital opened in 2018; the separate Elephant Conservation and Care Centre at Mathura began earlier. Reference: https://wildlifesos.org/conservation/elephant-conservation-care/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
